title: Sr Manager Commercial Operations Central Eastern Europe - Healthcare - Austria
description:
The Company
Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ: DXCM) ist ein Pionier und weltweit führend im Bereich der kontinuierlichen Glukoseüberwachung (CGM). Dexcom begann als kleines Unternehmen mit einem großen Traum: Die Art und Weise, wie Diabetes behandelt wird, für immer zu verändern. Informationen und Erkenntnisse zugänglich zu machen, die zu besseren gesundheitlichen Ergebnissen führen. Heute, 25 Jahre später, haben wir eine ganze Branche geprägt - und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Wir erweitern unsere Vision über Diabetes hinaus, um Menschen zu befähigen, ihre Gesundheit selbst in die Hand zu nehmen. Das bedeutet: personalisierte, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse, die darauf abzielen, wichtige gesundheitliche Herausforderungen zu lösen. Unser Ziel bleibt: Die menschliche Gesundheit zu verbessern.

Angetrieben werden wir von Tausenden ehrgeiziger, leidenschaftlicher Menschen weltweit, die wie Kämpfer darum ringen, das Vertrauen unserer Kundinnen und Kunden zu gewinnen - durch Zuhören, Integrität, große Visionen und Verlässlichkeit. Wir haben bereits Millionen Leben verändert - und sind bereit, Millionen weitere zu verändern.
Unsere Zukunftsvision ist es, ein führendes Unternehmen im Bereich der Gesundheitstechnologie für Verbraucher zu werden, während wir weiterhin Lösungen für ernsthafte Gesundheitsprobleme entwickeln. Wir werden dieses Ziel erreichen, indem wir kontinuierlich einzigartige Erfahrungen mit Biosensor-Technologie neu erfinden. Auch wenn wir weit von unseren Anfängen als kleines Unternehmen entfernt sind - unsere Träume sind größer denn je. Die Chance, die Gesundheit weltweit zu verbessern, liegt vor uns.

Sr Manager Commercial Operations Central Eastern Europe

Are you passionate about shaping the future of healthcare? At Dexcom , our newly created Commercial team is focused on expanding the market and deliver growth in Central (Eastern) Europe or CEE : Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia and Hungary. Executing on strategy in these countries, partnering and collaborating with our Distributors in that region, will be key to being successful.

The position is based in Austria, alternatively Slovenia. Cross border commuting (hybrid) is not available for this role. Relocation will be supported.

Where you come in:

• You will lead commercial strategies across the CEE region (Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Hungary), guiding and partnering with local distributors to achieve and exceed quarterly and annual targets.

• You will plan and coordinate all commercial activities within your region, including forecasting, reporting, investments, and business planning.

• You will be responsible for co-leading and developing the commercial teams working with our distributor partners, maximizing their potential and performance through joint field visits, coaching, feedback, and tailored development plans.

• You will develop and manage cross-functional relationships to build a high-performing regional team, collaborating closely with Marketing, Market Access, and Medical Affairs to provide comprehensive support to our distributors and help more patients benefit from our therapies.

• You will focus on increasing Dexcom ’s market share and achieving revenue and patient targets in line with company goals, values, and culture.

• You will contribute to the development and delivery of innovative training programs on Dexcom products and related solutions for healthcare professionals and patients.

• You will drive the effective use of CRM systems by our distributors to identify business development opportunities, improve customer engagement, and increase field force efficiency.

• You will strengthen Dexcom ’s brand awareness across the region through targeted initiatives developed in close collaboration with Marketing, Market Access, and Medical Affairs.

title: Inside Sales Representative- Advertising Executive

Are you a self-motivated "hunter" who thrives on variety? Guide Book Publishing , an industry leader since 1991, is looking for a strategic Advertising Account Executive. Unlike traditional sales roles where you call the same list for years, our team moves to a new assignment every 2-3 weeks , helping local businesses across 24 states reach "micro-communities" through high-quality direct-mail advertising.

How it Works

•
The Workflow: You’ll switch assignments frequently, focusing on businesses within a 3-5 mile radius of a specific congregation or community center.

•
The Method: 70% of your time is spent on high-energy outreach (phone, email, and video meetings); 20% on market research; and 10% on contract execution.

•
The Flexibility: This is a remote role, but does require getting your materials back to the Post Office to return to the Home Office.

Key Responsibilities

•
New Business Development: Identify and close new advertising partnerships to meet production goals.

•
Consultative Sales: Educate local business owners on the ROI of being featured in our community guides and directories.

•
Relationship Management: Act as the primary liaison between your clients and our operations staff to ensure an excellent experience.

•
Account Growth: Nurture and maintain large-scale accounts within your metro area.

•
Administrative Precision: Manage contracts and paperwork accurately and return assignment materials via USPS upon completion.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a structure that rewards high performers and provides security through a comprehensive benefits package via ADP TotalSource.

•
Draw & Commission: Payroll is based on "Cash In" from sales, with a Draw program available to stabilize income as you build your funnel.

•
Benefits:

• 401(k) with Company Match

Qualifications

Mindset: A self-starter who can manage their own schedule without being micromanaged.

•
Skills: Proficient in Excel, scanning, email, and PDF management. Strong ability to calculate discounts and commissions accurately.

Communication: Persuasive verbal skills and clear, professional written communication.

Why Guide Book Publishing ?

We serve the communication needs of over 800 micro-communities. If you are looking for a role that balances the freedom of remote work with the fast-paced nature of community-based sales, we want to talk to you.

title: MRB Mechanical Engineering Manager, Fury

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Dominance and Strike MRB Mechanical Engineering Team supports the production, sustainment, and airworthiness of Group 5 air vehicles and missile platforms. The team is focused on keeping fielded and in-production systems flying - evaluating nonconforming hardware, driving Material Review Board (MRB) dispositions, resolving production issues, and ensuring mechanical subsystems meet performance and safety requirements throughout their operational lifecycle. The team works at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, and quality to maintain the pace of production without compromising airworthiness.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead and grow a team of mechanical sustainment engineers responsible for evaluating nonconforming mechanical hardware and determining engineering dispositions on fielded and in-production Group 5 air vehicles

• Hire, mentor, and develop engineers on the team, including establishing a path to MRB signature/delegated authority for team members

• Set technical standards and review complex or high-risk dispositions and repairs, acting as an escalation point for the most difficult nonconformances on mechanical subsystems, actuation, and structural-mechanical interfaces

• Own team workload and prioritization, ensuring dispositions and repairs are generated accurately and on schedule to keep production flowing

• Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Design Engineering, and Supply Chain leadership to resolve cross-functional blockers and align on priorities

• Drive root cause and corrective action (RCCA) programs across the team to reduce recurring nonconformances and production escapes

• Build and continuously improve MRB processes, tools, and standard work for mechanical hardware as production rates increase

• Report on team throughput, nonconformance trends, and open risk to engineering and program leadership

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers on MRB discipline, mechanical fundamentals, and cross-functional coordination

• Travel to vendor, production, and test sites as needed to support hardware builds and troubleshoot issues directly

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 10+ years of mechanical engineering experience, including direct experience evaluating nonconformances and dispositioning hardware in a production, depot, or maintenance environment

• 2+ years of experience leading or managing engineers, either as a people manager or in a senior technical leadership capacity

• Proficiency with 3D CAD tools (CATIA, Siemens NX, Creo, or SolidWorks) and strong command of GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis

• Ability to perform and review structural and mechanical analysis (stress, deflection, fatigue) using hand calculations and FEA tools (ANSYS, NASTRAN, or equivalent)

• Demonstrated ability to set technical standards and review others' work across a team of engineers

• Excellent cross-functional communication skills - able to represent the team to Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and senior engineering leadership

• Self-driven with strong autonomy and adaptability in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

title: Contract Engineer, Automotive
description:
logcat.ai is the AI engineering layer for the operating-system stack. We build agentic systems for Linux and Android devices: we ingest the diagnostic artifacts a device emits (bugreports, logcat, dmesg, modem traces, ramdumps, perfetto, pcap, CAN) and help device makers diagnose, remediate, test, and author features across their OS stack, grounded in their own BSP. Think Datadog and Cursor combined for the OS layer. A VC-backed startup with a small, senior team - you work directly with the founders.

We recently raised a $2.55M pre-seed. The product is scaling and the customer list is growing. The team is still small, so you'll own what you build.

Build the automotive substrate adapter. Modern cockpit dumps are dual-OS on one SoC, and nobody diagnoses across that boundary well. You'll change that.

This is a scoped, deliverable-based contract with a path to a full-time Member of Technical Staff role.

A note on location

Remote, with at least four hours of overlap with Pacific or IST. We don't track hours. We ask for the overlap because a lot of this work is debugging together in real time, and that doesn't work across a twelve-hour gap. If you're in Seattle or Bengaluru, we'd like to meet in person now and then. It isn't a requirement.

The bar

• 10+ years of relevant engineering experience.

• Automotive embedded experience.

• AUTOSAR (Classic and/or Adaptive).

• CAN / CAN-FD and DBC-level fluency.

• UDS / DoIP diagnostics, SOME/IP, and ECU or domain/zonal architecture.

• DLT, with QNX a strong plus.

• Proficient in day-to-day work with CLI-based AI coding tools like Claude Code (or an equivalent). It's how the team operates, not a nice-to-have.

What you'll do

• Parse and correlate dual-OS cockpit dumps: QNX SLOG2, DLT traces, Android IVI logs, perfetto, pcap, CAN.

• Solve cross-clock-domain correlation across DLT ECU time, QNX monotonic, kernel monotonic, and Android boottime/realtime.

• Build the automotive diagnostic path: UDS, DoIP, DTCs.

Bonus

• AAOS or AAOS SDV, including VHAL.

• Hypervisor-based cockpits (QNX Hypervisor).

• Functional safety (ISO 26262) literacy.

• Vector toolchain (CANoe, CANalyzer).

What we offer you

• A front seat as we scale. Customer calls, the roadmap, the pipeline, how the company is actually doing.

• The AI tools you need. We use AI across writing code, reviewing it, research, ops, and internal tooling. If something would help you work better, we'll get it.

• Early ownership, and full visibility. We move fast, and you'll help decide where.

• A small team that's easy to work with. People here like solving hard problems and helping each other out.

What to expect after you apply

• Screening call with Head of People & Business Operations

• Technical conversation with Co-founder/ Head of Engineering

• Technical exercise with Co-founder/ Head of Engineering

• Final conversation with CEO

• References, then offer

In your application, tell us what you'd own here, and the hardest thing you've shipped in this domain.

title: Senior Account Executive - Credit & Lending Products
locationText: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
description:
Building Mercury's customer base has turned out to be a wild endeavor! With our continued growth in lending, we're looking for a seasoned credit and capital sales professional to continue to grow our capital products. This role focuses on selling to established, high-value mid-market brands generating millions in annual sales revenue. You'll bring the skills of a proven lending closer, someone who's structured and closed credit deals, while still thriving in the fast-moving, resourceful environment Mercury is known for.

You'll partner with founders and finance teams to understand their cash flow and capital needs on a deep level, and translate that understanding into credit-sound offers alongside underwriting. This role focuses on building your own pipeline of exceptional companies, starting with high-quality ecommerce brands, and expanding over time to other industries doing $20M-$500M in annual revenue. You'll own complex deal cycles that require both a strong banking relationship and real internal selling across underwriting and the executive team.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

This might be the right role for you if:

• You've sold credit and lending products before, either at a fintech lender or bank. 

• You don't wait for a pipeline to show up - you go find it, through outbound, networking, and relationship-building.

• You've managed a deal cycle that took months, involved a term sheet, and required you to keep multiple internal and external stakeholders aligned at once.

• When underwriting says no to a deal you like, you understand why, and you know how to bring back a structure that works for everyone. 

You will:

• Own the full sales cycle from self-sourced pipeline to close, selling Mercury's working capital products (term loans and rolling lines) to high-growth brands generating $20M-$500M in annual revenue.

• Build and maintain a high-quality pipeline through self-prospecting, outbound campaigns, and strategic networking.

• Run deep discovery to understand a business's growth trajectory, cash flow patterns, and capital needs, then work with underwriting to structure compelling, credit-sound offers for complex, high-value deals.

• Sell internally as much as externally: build consensus across underwriting and the executive team to move deals forward without cutting corners on credit quality.

• Manage long, multi-stakeholder deal cycles - often involving founders, CFOs, and existing lenders or banking relationships - while creating urgency and maintaining momentum.

• Negotiate deal terms that work for both the business and Mercury, balancing growth ambition with credit discipline.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to expand relationships into other Mercury products (banking*, credit card, treasury) as the account grows.

• Share market and customer insight that helps shape how Mercury underwrites and prices working capital over time.

You have:

• 3+ years of quota-carrying, closing experience selling credit, lending, or capital products - at a fintech lender, a bank's business/commercial lending group, or a similar working-capital provider.

• A track record of closing deals with businesses doing meaningful revenue (think $20M+, ideally into the tens or hundreds of millions), in ecommerce or adjacent industries.

• Real comfort with credit fundamentals - you can speak fluently about cash flow, underwriting considerations, and deal structuring, not just product features.

• Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that require internal alignment (underwriting, credit committee, leadership) as much as external persuasion.

• A demonstrated ability to self-source pipeline through outbound, networking, and relationship-building - not just work inbound leads.

• Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales methodology, preferred but not required.

• Genuine curiosity

title: Talent Development Manager (Learning& Leadership Development)

title: Senior Security Risk Analyst, GRC
description:
About the Team
DoorDash’s Global Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team helps the business scale securely through practical risk-based decisions, reliable controls and clear accountability. Our third-party risk program protects the systems and data behind our marketplace across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.
About the Role
We're hiring a Security Risk Specialist, who will help run and shape our risk management program and treatment plans, enabling risk and control owners and security teams to keep risk at an acceptable level as the business grows. You will work cross-functionally to achieve business goals by running risk assessments and reporting, supporting exception requests when a policy can't be met, and helping automate the tooling and processes that keep our risk register accurate and trustworthy. You'll also help us build a more proactive risk function - going into specific areas of the business to deep-dive their controls, surface where things have gone wrong, and get ahead of issues before they surface.
You will report into the Senior Security Risk Manager on our GRC team in our Security organization.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Lead our global risk management process (assessing risk, negotiating treatment plans with owners, turning regulatory and framework changes into real, working controls)

• Get into the detail of how controls operate day-to-day, factoring in threat intelligence to make sure we stay ahead of new threat actors and attack vectors

• Manage policy exceptions by building compensatory controls or a case for risk acceptance instead

• Own risk reporting for key areas like security or engineering, becoming the go-to risk contact for at least one and helping reduce risk there in a measurable way

• Collaborate and report widely within our GRC and security teams and across the business

• Help shape our team’s strategy and tooling as we grow by building your own automations rather than waiting on an engineer to build them for you

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 4+ years of experience in security risk, GRC, or a related field.

• You have a Bachelor's degree in a technology-related field, or an additional 4 years of work experience in a technology-related field.

• You're fluent in risk management frameworks, including the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).

• You know how to translate technical risk into language both technical and non-technical audiences can act on.

• You have strong written and verbal communication skills, and can turn complex control requirements into clear, actionable guidance.

• You're comfortable owning risk metrics and reporting, and can show - not just assert - that a program is working.

• You have experience automating workflows, or an interest in agentic AI workflows.

Nice to have:

• You have experience implementing or using GRC tooling.

title: Senior Customer Marketing Manager, EMEA
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re looking for an innovative and hands-on Senior Customer Marketing Manager to put Harvey’s EMEA customers centre stage: telling their stories, celebrating their wins, and building community around them.

Harvey has an incredible base of law firm and in-house customers across the region, and they are truly innovating the practice of law. Your first job is to elevate their voices: finding the customers doing standout work, earning their trust, and producing the written, video and spoken stories that put that work in front of the industry.

From there, the role expands into community programming: building the communities, programmes and moments (power user groups, customer roundtables, awards and recognition moments, customer-led content) that bring customers and the wider legal community together.

You’ll sit within the EMEA Marketing team and work hand in glove with our global Customer Engagement team, who own the overarching customer marketing strategy, programmes and playbooks. Your job is to make them work for EMEA: adapting them for the region’s markets, customers and culture, building what the region needs on top, and feeding what you learn back into the global motion. You’ll also partner closely with Customer Success and Sales. As the first dedicated customer marketer in the region, you won’t inherit a finished playbook. You’ll help write it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Localise the global motion for EMEA: take the programmes, playbooks and frameworks our Customer Engagement team builds globally and tailor them specifically for EMEA markets, customers and culture, working hand-in-hand to build a truly exceptional motion.

- Build the EMEA customer story pipeline: work across customer-facing teams to find the customers doing standout work, secure their participation and approvals, and keep a steady flow of stories in production.

- Tell their stories: own written stories, video stories, quotes and references end to end and to a standard the customer is proud to share.

- Get the stories seen: package each story for the channels that give it reach, localised for priority EMEA markets, and make sure Sales knows what exists and how to use it.

- Build the advocate bench: develop a roster of EMEA customers who can act as references, speakers, panellists and peer connectors, and track their participation so no one is over-asked and everyone gets recognised.

- Build EMEA community programmes: design and run the formats that bring customers together, such as power user groups, customer roundtables, practitioner communities, awards and recognition moments, each with clear goals and structured follow-up.

- Build repeatable playbooks and processes: the story production workflow, approvals process, reference tracking and community op

title: Account Executive
description:
UK | Full-time | Remote
Explorance is looking for a driven Account Executive to grow our presence in the UK higher education market.
This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys the hunt: identifying opportunities, opening new accounts, creating pipeline, engaging senior decision-makers, and turning complex conversations into closed business.
You'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through solution positioning, negotiation, and close, while partnering with Marketing, Sales Engineering, and other teams to bring the right Explorance solutions to prospective customers.
If you're a proactive SaaS seller who doesn't wait for opportunities to come to you, enjoys building a territory, and is motivated by ambitious targets and winning new business, we'd like to hear from you.
What you'll do

• Build your territory: Develop and execute a focused territory strategy to identify and win new business across the UK higher education market.

• Create pipeline: Proactively generate opportunities through outbound prospecting, cold outreach, networking, events, referrals, and targeted account development.

• Open new accounts: Identify the right stakeholders, create entry points into target organizations, and build relationships with senior and C-level decision-makers.

• Own the sales cycle: Manage opportunities from initial outreach and discovery through demonstrations, proposals, negotiation, and close.

• Sell strategically: Understand prospective customers' challenges and position Explorance 's solutions around their priorities, needs, and desired outcomes.

• Navigate complex deals: Build consensus across multiple stakeholders and confidently manage both shorter opportunities and longer, complex SaaS sales cycles.

• Collaborate to win: Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, and internal subject-matter experts throughout the sales process.

• Represent Explorance : Build market presence through industry events, conferences, webinars, and other networking opportunities.

• Know your market: Develop strong knowledge of Explorance 's solutions, the higher education landscape, competitors, and emerging market needs.

What we're looking for
Above all, we're looking for a hunter, someone who is energized by creating opportunities and winning new customers.
You'll ideally bring:

• 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of achieving or exceeding quota.

• Demonstrated success in new-logo acquisition and outbound business development.

• Experience building pipeline rather than relying primarily on inbound opportunities.

• Strong prospecting skills and the confidence to engage senior and C-level decision-makers.

• Experience managing the full SaaS sales cycle, from first contact through negotiation and close.

• Strong territory and account planning skills.

• A proactive, resilient, and results-driven approach to sales.

• Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.

• The ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Willingness to travel across the UK and internationally when required.

Nice to have

• Experience selling into higher education or similarly complex organizations.

• Experience with feedback, analytics, employee experience, or education technology solutions.

• Experience selling SaaS solutions involving multiple stakeholders and longer sales cycles.

Why Explorance ?
Explorance provides the opportunity to sell established SaaS solutions while continuing to expand our footprint in the UK higher education market. You'll have ownership of your territory and the opportunity to build relationships with leading institutions, create new business from the ground up, and work alongside experienced teams across Sales, Marketing, and Sales Engineering.
Location & Travel
This position is UK-based, and candidates must currently reside in the UK. The role requires regular travel to meet prospective customers

title: Cloud Architect
description:
How we work ?

Ofelia Perks & Benefits
About the role
We are building our cloud offering to a full SaaS model, and building a new Architecture team to lead that shift.
You'll partner closely with our Head of Architecture on the software-and-cloud vision, and work day to day with the Cloud/DevOps and Platform teams. You'll have real ownership over how we build, secure, and scale the platform as it grows from where it is today toward a multi-tenant, multi-customer product.
How we work -Architecture built together
This role comes with real autonomy, on purpose. Our Head of Architecture will be closely involved at the start, introducing you to the teams and setting direction, and will then step back to let you drive your own scope. We're not looking for someone to manage closely; we're looking for someone who can take a blank page and own it, and who knows when to loop others in.
The Architecture team itself is still taking shape, so a lot of how we work will be built together with you. In practice, that means direct, frequent exchanges with the teams below rather than layers of process, closer to mentorship and architecture review than top-down direction:

• Head of Architecture (hiring manager) : software & AI architecture, partnering for a unified product vision

• Cloud/DevOps team : daily collaboration and mentoring

• Platform team : cross-cutting architecture topics

• Information Security Officer : validating cloud security choices

The day-to-day job
Day to day, you'll own the cloud side of that transition end to end:

• Design and evolve the platform's multi-tenant cloud architecture (tenant isolation, data models, onboarding flows), robust, scalable, and secure, with AWS as the primary provider and a second cloud provider

• Define and promote architecture best practices: high availability, resilience, cost optimization (FinOps)

• Lead containerization and orchestration with Kubernetes (cluster design, networking, security, observability, lifecycle management)

• Industrialize provisioning and deployments through Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (GitOps)

• Integrate and operationalize generative AI services, notably Amazon Bedrock (model selection, RAG, AI usage governance)

• Own the cloud security architecture, in partnership with our Information Security Officer, who covers ISO 27001/SOC 2 compliance: IAM, encryption, network segmentation, cluster hardening, threat modeling

• Define operational resilience practices: disaster recovery (RTO/RPO), backup strategy, SLA/SLO

• Mentor and upskill the DevOps and engineering teams

• Maintain active technology watch and challenge existing architecture choices

What success looks like
30 days: Understand and diagnose

• You've completed a full audit of the current platform: Kubernetes setup (shared cluster, namespace-per-tenant), network, IaC and CI/CD maturity, and you've mapped the gaps against a production-grade SaaS (HA, horizontal scalability, WAF, observability).

• You've built working relationships with the Cloud/DevOps and Platform teams and established a lightweight architecture review ritual with them.

• You share a prioritized diagnosis with the Head of Architecture: what's solid, what's at risk, what blocks our first customer.

60 days : Define the target and unblock

• The target multi-tenant architecture is documented and validated: tenant isolation model, HA strategy, horizontal scaling approach, and the security baseline (including WAF).

• The IaC and GitOps roadmap is defined, and the first components are managed through Terraform and automated pipelines.

• You've identified the integration pattern for generative AI services (Amazon Bedrock) and validated it with the Platform team.

90 days : Execute toward our first customer

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. The EW Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware for Electromagnetic Warfare. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.

As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer within EW, you will be responsible for driving process improvements, ensuring the highest quality of production, and supporting the development and implementation of new products. You will play a crucial role in optimizing manufacturing processes, reducing costs, and increasing efficiencies on existing technologies while also developing new products and scaling to full scale production.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain that includes Assembly, Integration & Test (AI&T) for electro-mechanical assemblies

• Contribute to operational excellence with a strong continuous improvement mindset and leading impactful Kaizen events

• Be a strong partner with Product Quality Engineering to drive and support RCCA burndowns that tackle key issues both internally and externally to EW Production

• Collaborate with Design Engineering teams in early to late phases of the development process to provide DFx for smooth NPI transitions

• Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes

• Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.

• Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production

• Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware

• Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Degree in a technical field preferred such as engineering, math, or a hard science

• 8+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware

• Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment

• Demonstrated ability to contribute to the delivery of electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment

• Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.) Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus.

• Prior experience working with JIRA, Siemens NX, Teamcenter (PLM), or Oracle (ERP) or equivalents

• Experience with RF Products that require system AI&T (assembly, integration, and test)

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

title: GTM Engineer (Fresh grad, India)
description:
Location: 100% Remote from India, min. 4h overlap with CET (e.g. 9:00-13:00 CET). Fluent English, spoken and written. German is not required.

Compensation: 20k-32k USD per year (depending on location) + Shares + Generous Benefits. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab https://about.gitlab.com/blog/2019/02/28/why-we-pay-local-rates/.

About Secfix

Secfix automates security compliance for SMBs and mid-market companies in Europe and gets them compliant with ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX and SOC 2 in weeks instead of months. We’re a fast-growing team of 36 people, backed by a $12M Series A from Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank) and Bayern Capital.

About the Role

You’ll be our first GTM Engineer and build the system our entire go-to-market team runs on, from BDRs to AEs. Today, everyone runs their own setup for data, outreach and communication. You’ll replace that with one central, automated system and keep it reliable as we grow. This is a hands-on engineering role: you’ll write code (Python, SQL) every day, connect APIs and build data pipelines and AI workflows, not configure tools or run RevOps. You report to our Head of GTM, talk to everyone in GTM, spot the biggest bottlenecks and decide together what to build next. We own products and outcomes, not Jira tickets.

What You'll Do

- Data: Make our CRM the single source of truth for every target account. Model accounts, contacts and buying committees, and build automated pipelines that pull data from multiple sources, deduplicate, score and write it back.

- Pipeline generation: Build signal-based outbound, inbound scoring and routing, and alerts that tell the right rep which account to call today and why.

- Sales automation: Build AI tools and agents that take repetitive work off our AEs, from research to proposals to CRM updates.

- GTM infrastructure: Design our central data layer, integrate new tools via APIs and webhooks, and make sure everything runs reliably: scheduled jobs, error handling, monitoring and alerts when something breaks.

- Ownership end-to-end: Investigate problems, find the root cause, ship the fix and document it so nothing depends on one person.

Your success: reps spend less time on manual work and more time with customers, and more pipeline comes from systems that run reliably and are actually used.

About You

You’re an engineer who loves building things real people use every day, and are curious about the business. You build systems that run reliably at 10x volume, not one-off scripts.

- Recent graduate (0-2 years) in Computer Science or another engineering field with a strong academic record.

- 1+ years of experience through your first full-time job or internships in a startup environment.

- Solid Python and hands-on experience with APIs and webhooks.

- You know how to run code in production: version control (Git), scheduling, handling errors and rate limits, logging and debugging.

- You think in systems: you understand how components depend on each other and what breaks when you change one part.

- Smart, structured problem solver and fast learner: you pick up new tools and technologies on your own and bring complexity down.

- Hands-on experience with Claude (incl. Claude Code or the API). This is a must-have.

- You’ve built and shipped real things (an automation, scraper, data pipeline or internal tool) and can show them.

- Independent, proactive and comfortable communicating remotely, especially in writing.

Nice to have: SQL and data modeling, experience with a CRM, GTM tools like Clay, a data warehouse or a cloud platform.

You should not apply if:

- You need detailed tickets telling you what to build.

- You only want to write code and don’t care about business impact.

- You don’t want to test, monitor and maintain what you ship.

- You’d rather be led than lead your own projects.

- You don’t want to work closely with Sales and the people who use your tools.

From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

We're a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

We're looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI.

THE ROLE

This is an opportunity to own multiple components of our growth function in one of Encord's fastest-growing markets: from our billboards or campaigns on X, to our exec dinners, founder PR or flagship annual summit. You'll have a founder-mentality, move with relentless urgency, and own outcomes rather than tasks.

If you want to start a company one day, or already have, this is a chance to help build a hyper-growth GTM function from 0 to 1. You'll own important growth outcomes for the company, work directly with leadership and our founders, and get as much scope as you can handle (as fast as you can earn it). Our team is small and we all roll up our sleeves, from packing hundreds of swag boxes, to cold outbounding a famous podcast to book our founders an interview.

Some of what you could own in your first months:

- Growth hacks: come up with scrappy, creative ways to get in front of the AI leaders at the companies we most want to work with

- A bold IRL launch: take an out-of-home campaign or stunt in New York or SF from idea to street, owning the concept, budget, locations and distribution

- Executive dinners: own multiple exec dinners with the AI teams at the companies we most want to work with; own pipeline goals and oversee the logistics

- Content and PR: own the ideation, budget, schedule and distribution of high-value content that reflects our leadership in the space

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own Encord's growth end-to-end, helping pick the bets, own the execution and achieve ambitious growth goals for the company

- Become the Encord product and customer expert - you'll know our customers by name, deeply understand why leading AI teams choose Encord and how to accelerate our growth

- Take full ownership of projects as you prove yourself, coming up with your own ideas for how Encord can grow and executing on them

- Help build an exceptional growth team that delivers on larger and larger outcomes, as we rapidly scale

- Own the outcome: examine the performance of what we're delivering, track results and proactively identify what's working/not working (and quickly adapt)

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 4+ years in a high-velocity environment: starting a company as a founder, top-tier banking or investing, early hire at a hyper-growth startup, or similar.

- High-agency and founder-mentality: you have a strong sense of self-initiative and always find a creative solution around obstacles where others get stuck

- Eager for a non-linear growth path (and driven to put in the work needed to achieve it)

- Customer-centric and sales-focused: you want to deeply understand how our business works, why our customers choose Encord and what makes a 'great' Encord customer; you want to learn to speak the language of our market and be respected by customers/prospects, have them on speed-dial

- Ruthlessly focused on results: you set and internalize our north start metrics and goals, and refuse to spend time on 'vanity' tas

As an organisation, we push the boundaries of data science, optimisation and artificial intelligence to solve the most complex problems in the industry. title: Staff Robotics Software Engineer
tags: Air Dominance & Strike : Air Dominance & Strike Engineering : Mission Software Engineering
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Dominance team builds Mission Autonomy for Group 5 Collaborative Combat Aircraft, uncrewed platforms designed to fly alongside crewed and uncrewed aircraft, delivering affordable mass in contested environments. We build the Mission Autonomy, not the flight controls: the decision-maker for the entire mission, from startup through execution to shutdown. Many sensors in, one trusted decision out, explainable enough to certify. That's the problem you'd own.

ABOUT THE JOB

Staff Robotics Engineers lead the delivery of mission autonomy capability, acting as technical leads, senior individual contributors, and/or as team leads that are also hands-on contributors. This includes operational analysis and concept of employment modelling, autonomy architecture and implementation, mission and route planning, task allocation and multi-ship coordination, crewed-uncrewed teaming interfaces, contingency and health management, behaviour analysis and the assurance evidence that supports airworthiness, simulation and test infrastructure, and interfaces with lower-level vehicle autonomy and higher-level command and control. We expect Staff Robotics Engineers to demonstrate unparalleled end-to-end outcome ownership, driving the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of safe and effective mission autonomy on Anduril's autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own customer success through the design and delivery of a multi-year, multi-stakeholder software roadmap that spans across multiple teams

• Leverage internal product and program-specific engineering teams to rapidly deliver capability beyond the scope of current platforms, with a clear path for both architecture and capability evolution over time

• Partner with external teams, collaborating on interfacing requirements between diverse systems and technologies

• Lead teams that architect, design and implement trusted safe navigation, collision avoidance, and situational awareness systems that balance constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment

• Drive the development and implementation of sensor suites, perception algorithms, planning algorithms, and test fixtures to deliver safe navigation and effective operation of Anduril’s autonomous vehicles

• Perform high impact IC work in architecture and implementation across the whole perception and planning stack

• Utilise advanced techniques in computer vision, sensor fusion, and machine learning to enhance perception and planning capabilities of Anduril vehicles

• Conduct thorough testing and validation of perception and planning algorithms through development and use of simulation and analysis of data from real-world experiments, including evolving the data analysis tooling.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, mechanical engineers, and systems engineers, to ensure effective system integration and testing

• Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 20% of the time

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience

• 7+ years of experience in C++ and/or Python softw

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

- Set up the processes for capturing expertise from top performers and from customer engagements, curating it, keeping it current, and retiring what is stale.

- Establish taxonomy, ownership, and governance for team knowledge, including how it is tagged by practice area, customer segment, and sales stage.

BUILD PROGRAMS THAT MAKE LEGAL ENGINEERS EXCELLENT

- Design and run onboarding and certification programs covering product mastery, legal practice and workflow fluency, discovery, solution design, and presenting to lawyers and law firm leadership.

- Create coaching, peer-learning, and practice-group deep-dive formats that put real legal work at the center of how the team learns.

- Translate how law firms think about training, precedent, and adoption into how we enable our own team and, through them, our customers.

title: Online Middle School Math Instructor
description:
Job Type: Full-Time (30-40 hours/week, W2);

Location: Remote (U.S. based)

Compensation: $35-45/hour for teaching + $16-20/hour for non-teaching/admin time
Join Think Academy as a full-time Math Teacher. Teach with a structured, high-quality curriculum, receive paid training, and grow into long-term teaching and curriculum roles. This is a long-term teaching opportunity - not a short-term tutoring role. About Think Academy

Think Academy US , a wholly owned subsidiary of TAL Education Group (NYSE: TAL), is a leading education company dedicated to helping K-12 students build strong academic foundations, confidence in math, and long-term learning ability through high-quality teaching and thoughtfully designed curriculum.

Why This Role Is Different

Most teaching roles expect you to build everything yourself. Here, you teach within a structured instructional system - curriculum, lesson materials, training, and team support are already in place, so you can focus on teaching quality and student growth instead of building materials from scratch.

•
Stronger Teaching Support - high-quality curriculum and lesson materials, structured onboarding, ongoing training, and a team to collaborate with instead of teaching in isolation

•
Long-Term Career Growth - high performers can grow into Senior Teacher, Teacher Trainer, or Academic Operations/Management roles

•
Competitive, Growing Earnings - paid for both teaching and non-teaching work, with performance-based raises up to 3 times a year, and an end-of-semester commission

What You'll Do

• Teach math (Algebra 1, Geometry and above) in a clear, engaging, student-centered way, using our curriculum, lesson materials, and instructional guidance

• Lead virtual classes with ~18 students, creating a positive, high-expectation learning environment

• Grade homework, give timely feedback, and communicate professionally with students/parents on progress and learning plans

• Participate in training, lesson prep, and ongoing professional development

Schedule & Commitment

• ~3-6 classes/week (6-12 teaching hours), plus admin hours (grading, prep, parent comms) - total 30-40 hrs/week

• Class windows (Pacific Time): Wed-Fri, 4pm-8pm and Sat-Sun, 9am-8pm

• Once classes are assigned, your schedule stays consistent week to week (except federal holidays)

• We are looking for candidates who can commit to at least one year consistent teaching schedule

Compensation & Benefits

• Teaching Hours: $35-45/hour

• Non-Teaching/Admin Hours: $16-20/hour (grading, class prep, parent communication)

• Performance-based pay increases up to 3 times per year, plus end-of-semester commission targeted at 15-30% of total teaching compensation

• Qualified teachers may be assigned more long-term classes, or have expanded responsibilities

• Benefits: 401(k), health/dental/vision insurance (based on eligibility)

title: Senior AI Quality & Evaluation Engineer
description:
Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery-from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.

We are looking for a Senior AI Quality & Evaluation Engineer to own the independent proof that retrieval works and that permissions hold. You’ll build and run the golden question suite, negative entitlement tests, and drift alarms that serve as acceptance gates - so the engineers who built the system are not grading their own work.

This is a 50% allocation role across weeks 3-10, drawn from a Quality Engineering or GRC background, reporting to the POD Lead and working day-to-day with the retrieval engineer.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build the golden question suite from top contact drivers and needs workshops - question, expected source, expected passage, and acceptance thresholds for relevance, grounding, and citation accuracy, versioned alongside the content it tests.

- Build the negative entitlement test set - queries issued under unentitled identities that must return no restricted passage, with any failure raised as a severity-one alarm.

- Build freshness and retirement tests - source-modified-to-index-available lag per item against the agreed threshold, and verification that retired items disappear on the next sync.

- Automate the harness to run on schedule and after every content, configuration, or model change - publishing scores to the quality dashboard with trend lines and regression alarms.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Manifest
Manifest is building modern software for the tours and activities industry.
Our customers run real-world businesses: tours, attractions, experiences, rentals, and activities. They need software that helps them sell more, operate smoothly, and deliver great guest experiences.
We're building a B2B2C SaaS platform that brings booking, ecommerce, payments, accounting, operations, and customer experience together in a modern architecture. The product surface is broad, the workflows are nuanced, and the opportunity is big. That surface now spans several distinct product areas, including a newer, AI-native platform for building and delivering customer websites end-to-end. We're hiring more than one Senior Product Manager, and we'll match each hire to the area where their strengths fit best, from established features to fast-moving, zero-to-one greenfield work.
We're looking for Senior Product Managers to own product direction, roadmap, and prioritization for one or more key areas of Manifest.
This is not a backlog management role. We're looking for someone who can take ambiguous customer and business problems, find the shape of the opportunity, make smart tradeoffs, and help a cross-functional team ship high-quality product experiences.
About the Role
As a Senior Product Manager, you'll turn customer insight, business context, and technical possibilities into clear product direction and own the delivery end-to-end.
Modern product work is changing, and this role reflects that. We expect our PMs to be fluent and genuinely enthusiastic users of AI-assisted tools-using Claude, Cursor, v0, and similar tools to explore interactions, build lightweight prototypes, and make product ideas concrete before implementation begins. On some of our teams, AI-native workflows are not just a way of working faster; they're central to the product itself.
You'll work closely with Product leadership, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and design-minded front-end engineers. Depending on the area you own, there may not be a dedicated product designer, so you should be comfortable playing an active role in shaping user workflows, interaction patterns, and overall product quality.

You'll also be the bridge between executive vision and execution: taking high-level direction set by our leadership team and honing it into concrete, buildable product requirements. Leadership helps frame the why and the what, but you own the product decisions about what to build and how to bring it to life.
You do not need to be a front-end engineer, and you won't be expected to write production code. But strong technical fluency is a real advantage-enough to collaborate deeply with engineers on UI-heavy, technically nuanced product areas, and to understand the systems you're shaping. A technical or former engineering background is strongly preferred.
You should also be comfortable owning the delivery side of the work, along with the product vision, like milestones, sequencing, and keeping a small team moving.
What You'll Do

• Own roadmap, prioritization, delivery, and product outcomes for one or more areas of Manifest

• Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their businesses, and the tours and activities industry

• Lead discovery with customers, internal stakeholders, support teams, sales, customer success, and go-to-market partners

• Translate customer problems, business goals, and operational complexity into clear product direction

• Define product requirements, success metrics, release scope, and tradeoffs

• Partner closely with engineering to shape pragmatic, high-quality solutions, and help sequence and drive delivery

• Work closely with front-end engineers on user flows, interaction details, edge cases, and product polish

• Use AI-assisted tools, lightweight prototypes, wireframes, diagrams, and sketches to clarify product ideas and reduce ambiguity

• Help raise the bar for UX quality, including in areas without a dedicated Product Designer

title: Medical Director - Medicaid
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Medical Director relies on medical background and reviews health claims. The Medical Director work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Work Schedule 8am-5pm Central Standard Time
The Medical Director actively uses their medical background, experience, and judgement to make determinations whether requested services, requested level of care, and/or requested site of service should be authorized. All work occurs with a context of regulatory compliance, and work is assisted by diverse resources which may include national clinical guidelines, CMS policies and determinations, clinical reference materials, internal teaching conferences, and other sources of expertise. Medical Directors will learn Medicare and Medicare Advantage requirements, and will understand how to operationalize this knowledge in their daily work.

The Medical Director’s work includes computer based review of moderately complex to complex clinical scenarios, review of all submitted clinical records, prioritization of daily work, communication of decisions to internal associates, and possible participation in care management. The clinical scenarios predominantly arise from inpatient or post-acute care environments. Has discussions with external physicians by phone to gather additional clinical information or discuss determinations regularly, and in some instances these may require conflict resolution skills. Some roles include an overview of coding practices and clinical documentation, grievance and appeals processes, and outpatient services and equipment, within their scope.

The Medical Director may speak with contracted external physicians, physician groups, facilities, or community groups to support regional market priorities, which may include an understanding of Humana processes, as well as a focus on collaborative business relationships, value based care, population health, or disease or care management. Medical Directors support Humana values, and Humana ’s Bold Goal mission, throughout all activites.

Use your skills to make an impact

Responsibilities
The Medical Director provides medical interpretation and determinations whether services provided by other healthcare professionals are in agreement with national guidelines, CMS requirements, Humana policies, clinical standards, and (in some cases) contracts. The ideal candidate supports and collaborates with other team members, other departments, Humana colleagues and the Regional VP Health Services. After completion of mentored training, daily work is performed with minimal direction. Enjoys working in a structured environment with expectations for consistency in thinking and authorship. Exercises independence in meeting departmental expectations and meets compliance timelines. Supports the assigned work with respect to market-wide objectives (e.g. Bold Goal) and community relations as directed.
Required Qualifications

• MD or DO degree

• 5+ years of direct clinical patient care experience post residency or fellowship, which preferably includes some experience in an inpatient environment and/or related to care of a Medicaid type population .

• Current and ongoing Board Certification an approved ABMS Medical Specialty

• Current Louisiana and Oklahoma licenses, and/or ability to obtain additional licenses without conditions

• No current sanction from Federal or State Governmental organizations, and able to pass credentialing requirements.

• This position is open to all US Territory, with the requirement of working 8am-5pm Central Standard Time

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Evidence of analytic and interpretation skills, with prior experience participating in teams focusing on quality management, utilization management, case management, discharge planning and/or home health or post-acute services such as inpatient rehab

title: Executive & Personal Assistant, Founders’ Office
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Executive & Personal Assistant, Founders’ Office

Location: San Francisco, CA or New York, NY (In-office / Hybrid)

About the Role

Cloudflare is seeking an exceptional, highly organized, and discreet Executive & Personal Assistant to join our Founders’ Office support team. Based in either San Francisco or New York City , this role works in close alignment with two Senior Executive Business Partners who manage direct daily support for Cloudflare’s Co-Founders.

This is a versatile, high-touch role combining executive administrative support, event coordination, personal projects, and lifestyle logistics. You will provide critical execution capacity behind the scenes-anticipating needs effortlessly, moving between business and personal requests seamlessly, and ensuring every detail is handled with precision, follow-through, and strict confidentiality.

Key Responsibilities

• Executive & Founder Support: Manage executive calendar coordination, meeting logistics, priority tracking, expense reports, and backup support alongside the Senior Executive Business Partners.

• Travel & Itinerary Planning: Coordinate domestic and international executive and personal travel, including private aviation charters, luxury lodging, ground transportation, dining arrangements, and detailed door-to-door itineraries.

• Events & Entertaining: Plan and execute private dinners, VIP hospitality, and personal events, managing venue sourcing, guest lists, menus, invitations, and on-site vendor logistics.

• Personal & Lifestyle Support: Coordinate day-to-day personal logistics, appointments, dining reservations, executive gifting, wellness schedules, and ad-hoc errands.

• Special Projects: Assist with special research, bespoke purchasing, prospective property coordination, and vendor oversight for home/office maintenance and seasonal projects.

What You Bring

• Experience: 5+ years of experience supporting C-suite executives, Founders, or UHNW individuals in a combined executive and personal assistant capacity.

• Core Skills: Exceptional organization, eagle-eyed attention to detail, and proactive follow-through

• Travel & Hospitality Expertise: Deep experience booking, managing, and troubleshooting travel, including private aviation charters and luxury accommodations. You offer a high-touch concierge service.

• Professional Demeanor: Personable, polished, and collaborative, adept at partnering seamlessly
